reviewed.by: PENDING — NEW BUILD 2026-08-03. Deity tier: needs apologia-argument + apologia-orthodoxy + apologia-neutrality (dual consensus is the two doctrinal lenses, NOT the whole bar). Cards-only, no voiceover field, so every hedge and bound must live on a card — there is no second surface. SOURCES: library/jesus_claims.html (the Mark 2 / Mark 14 spine, the 'earliest Gospel' wording, and the bracketing-John orthonote at :174), library/jesus_as_god_nt.html (:175-177 honest-scope paragraphs), docs/book-research/did-jesus-really-say-he-was-god.md (Del Rosario: the two blasphemy scenes as the structure; ch.12's 'authority over sacred things, nature, demons, disease, death'; the implicit-claim point that Jesus did not need the words 'I am God'). BUILT-IN FENCES — each one is a known trap on this argument: (1) THE THEME MUST NOT IMPLY JOHN IS UNHISTORICAL. Del Rosario calibration flag 6: Mark-not-John is a STRATEGIC choice — meeting the skeptic on his own ground — never a concession that John is late-and-therefore-doubtful. Scene 12 carries this and must not be cut; jesus_claims.html:174 fences the same move with an orthonote ('Bracketing John, not doubting it'). (2) INFERENCE TO BEST EXPLANATION, NEVER PROOF. Del Rosario flag 1. Scene 10 says 'only God could claim that' — the claim is about what the words amount to, not a demonstration. Do not upgrade any card to 'proves'. (3) HOSTILE TESTIMONY IS THE ENGINE. The argument runs from the ENEMIES' reaction (scribes in ch.2, high priest in ch.14), which is why it survives 'his followers said so'. Keep scene 9. (4) MARK NEVER WRITES 'JESUS IS GOD' AND THE REEL MUST SAY SO (scene 10). Claiming Mark states it is false and a well-read skeptic closes the whole reel with one verse. (5) CHALCEDON — scene 11 affirms full humanity from Mark's own text (asleep 4:38, hungry 11:12, dead 15:37). This is the standing corpus gap logged in CLAUDE.md; a deity reel without it can leave a functionally monophysite Christ. (6) MARK 2:6 SAYS THE SCRIBES QUESTIONED 'IN THEIR HEARTS' — scene 4 says 'think', not 'say'. (7) NO CLAIM OF SCHOLARLY CONSENSUS that Mark carries a high Christology — Ehrman disputes exactly this, and an unattributed consensus claim is the registry-retired class. The reel asserts what Mark NARRATES and what the characters in it REACT to, which is not contestable. (8) 'The last Gospel written' / 'the earliest Gospel' are the standard datings and jesus_claims.html states Markan priority flatly in its own voice.

sub.t: John is the last Gospel written.
So let's use the first one.
